findings.name: resolved: all-caution day used to become no_go 'safety_hazard'
findings.detail: A day of steady 33 km/h onshore wind is now decision=go (hours are all CAUTION, {'caution'}). Before the fix the day-level decision treated any best window whose safety was CAUTION (not GO) as no_go/safety_hazard, contradicting the hourly label 'اذهب بحذر'. Fixed in _day_decision plus a near-limit escalation rule.

findings.name: go rate rose after the fix (was over-conservative)
findings.detail: After the fix, go=206 / 3000 (was 20/3000 before). The engine still leans conservative (reasons={'safety_hazard': 2174, 'official_warning': 451, 'critical_data_missing': 70, 'field_infeasible': 57, 'fouling_confirmed': 42}) because the fuzz samples many extreme values, but all-day caution scenarios no longer cancel the trip.

findings.name: conservative_uncertainty reason code appears unreachable in practice
findings.detail: Across 3000 randomized datasets the reason code CONSERVATIVE_UNCERTAINTY appeared 0 times; the only paths that set it require either a confidence score < 50 (only reachable through missing critical fields, which already yields critical_data_missing) or an all-GO/CAUTION day with no consecutive window (impossible for hourly contiguous data). The code path is effectively dead.
